speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hear the yard, and I can hear John at the outer door. I cannot hear a word I am owed. I am staying where I am.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stay. The outer door is their business. This door is a piece of wood, and I am on the dull side of it, which is the side I chose.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Your last piece is short. You know it. I am not going to walk you at it. A man who has been on once can find a door without being led.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can find it. I would rather find it late than find it with a speech prepared for the people on the benches. They have had what they paid for.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will be plain when I am wanted, and dull until then. The paint is dry enough to crack if I smile. I am not smiling for practice.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Nobody here requires it. Sit. The call will not be prettier for being waited on.
